authority.closed_list_note: Not a closed list: participating professionals contracted with a delegated medical group must follow the delegate's protocols (page 1), so prior authorization rules exist outside this document

edition.label: Effective October 1, 2026
edition.quote: Peoples Health Plans prior authorization requirements Effective October 1, 2026

bindings.note: Plans included: Medicare Advantage HMO, HMO-POS, PPO and Regional PPO plans, including AARP Medicare Advantage (page 1)

endpoints.quote: use the Prior Authorization and Notification tool on the UnitedHealthcare Provider Portal at UHCprovider.com. After you sign in, select the Prior Authorization link. From the "Create a new authorization submission" section, select Specialty Pharmacy from the dropdown menu. Or, you can call 888-397-8129

rules.quote: Prior authorization is not required for emergency or urgent care.

payload.submit_via: Prior Authorization and Notification tool, Specialty Pharmacy

row_statement.quote: For all plans including Erickson Advantage, prior authorization required

rules.quote: Intravenous Iron Replacement J1437 - Monoferric J1439 - Injectafer

rules.interpretation: J0885 is listed under 'Cancer supportive Care', whose requirement is stated for drugs 'administered in an outpatient setting for a cancer diagnosis'. Kanini reads 'cancer diagnosis' as ICD-10-CM C00-C96 (malignant neoplasms) and D00-D09 (in situ). For other diagnoses the list states nothing about J0885.
not_stated: plan exclusions on page 7 (UHC Nursing Home Plan, UHC Care Advantage I-SNP, Massachusetts DSNP) are not modelled as plans
rules.quote: For all plans including Erickson Advantage, prior authorization required for colony- stimulating factor drugs and bone-modifying agent(s) administered in an outpatient setting for a cancer diagnosis

not_drafted.reason: On the cited pages but outside the prototype's services (ESA and IV iron for CKD not on dialysis, scenario 3 uses J1439). J1437 (Monoferric) shares the J1439 row and the step therapy criteria; drafting it needs an IV iron concept covering both codes, left for the next edition of this pack.
